words.example: Before the briefing I will introduce the new person guiding the lobby.
words.exampleZh: 情况说明之前，我会介绍新来的大厅引导员。

words.example: When the new clerks reach the counter, welcome them by name.
words.exampleZh: 新文员走到柜台时，请称呼姓名欢迎他们。

words.example: Thank the night crew when you see them; they covered the late clinic.
words.exampleZh: 见到夜班同事时请感谢他们，晚间门诊是他们值的。

words.example: I apologize for the minutes; they went to the wrong mailbox.
words.exampleZh: 纪要发错了邮箱，我为此道歉。

words.example: She passed probation, so we should congratulate her before she leaves today.
words.exampleZh: 她通过了试用，我们该在她今天下班前祝贺她。

words.example: Success rate for lab messages dropped once the interface began retrying.
words.exampleZh: 接口一开始重试，检验消息的成功率就下降了。

words.example: P95 latency on the order screen crossed three seconds at the morning peak.
words.exampleZh: 早高峰时，医嘱界面的百分之九十五延迟超过了三秒。

words.example: P99 latency for opening a chart reached twelve seconds for a few doctors.
words.exampleZh: 少数医生打开病历时，百分之九十九延迟到了十二秒。

words.example: Cold start of the report service takes almost a minute after each deploy.
words.exampleZh: 每次部署之后，报表服务的冷启动要将近一分钟。

words.example: Warm start of the order service came back within a few seconds.
words.exampleZh: 医嘱服务的热启动几秒钟就回来了。
